notes.title: アップデート：不具合修正
notes.content:
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

・If you press "Start from the beginning of the stage" just before the game is over, the novel will be carried over and the game will be over even after restarting.

[h3]Chat[/h3]

It's been a month since the release.

Thanks to you, we have received "good reviews" on the store page.

We are also happy to see comments on streaming and SNS.

There are only a few bugs, so I think it will be a while before we get any updates.

(This means you can start working on the next game with peace of mind.)

Thank you for your continued support.

Kyuko
